title: elabs / Pixal3D
description: Pixal3D generates high-quality 3D models from a single input image. Supports OBJ/GLB export, texture baking, and multiple detail levels. API: POST JSON with {image_base64, detail_level, output_format, texture_resolution} -> {model_obj_base64, model_glb_base64, texture_base64, wall_time_s}. GPU: requires >=12GB VRAM (RTX 4090, L40S, A6000+). Weighted at 86 on the Human Preference Score v2 benchmark for 3D generation. Based on Pixal3D architecture with advanced multi-view diffusion and neural surface reconstruction. Runs entirely on RunPod serverless infrastructure with no network volume required.
